mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN roles r ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN users u ON u.role_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
